---
title: "GSEA"
description: "Run standard file-driven GSEA or reproduce the B73-Y12 phenylpropanoid figure from archived/current DEP rankings."
---

## Analysis modes

The current GSEA page starts with:

- **Standard GSEA**
- **B73-Y12 Figure reproduction**

These modes intentionally use different inputs.

## Standard GSEA

Standard mode remains file-driven. Upload:

1. **Expression Matrix** (`.txt`);
2. **Group Info** (`.txt`);
3. **KO Pathway Info** (`.txt`).

The standard workflow builds a differential ranking and runs `clusterProfiler::GSEA()`. Current controls include `minGSSize`, `maxGSSize`, Top X pathways, significant-only (`p.adjust < 0.05`), NES/p.adjust sorting, and a selected pathway for the enrichment curve.

Because the standard ranking step uses count-model logic, do not supply already log-transformed continuous protein intensities as though they were integer counts.

## B73-Y12 Figure reproduction

This mode works from previously stored DEP results rather than forcing the user to rebuild a separate expression/count input.

### Load comparisons

Click **LOAD PREVIOUS DEP RESULTS**. You can select multiple DEP comparisons, **Select all**, **Clear**, or choose **Root_VE only**. A separate **Focus comparison** determines which selected comparison is displayed in detail.

The reproduction pathway is currently fixed to **Phenylpropanoid biosynthesis** for the archived target.

### Root_VE reproduction source

Two sources are available:

- **Exact supplied figure (historical Root_VE)** — default exact target;
- **Recalculate from loaded DEP result** — rebuild the ranking from the selected stored comparison.

The frozen historical Root_VE target records **11,049 ranked proteins**, **196 map00940 hits**, the historical **B73 − Y12 log2FC** metric, and weighted GSEA **p = 1**. It is bundled specifically to match the supplied historical panel.

When recalculating from stored DEP, the ranking metric can be:

- moderated t statistic (script method);
- log2 fold change;
- signed `-log10(P-value)`.

Protein inclusion can use all tested proteins (the GSEA default) or custom thresholds.

::: {.callout-warning}
## Keep comparison direction consistent
Changing B73−Y12 to Y12−B73 reverses the ranked statistic and therefore the enrichment direction. Record the comparison direction and ranking metric with every exported GSEA figure.
:::

## Outputs

Both modes provide ranked-pathway results and pathway-level visualization/export. In reproduction mode, selected comparisons can be recalculated while Root_VE can remain locked to the exact historical archive when exact panel reproduction is required.

Use standard mode for new general-purpose GSEA; use archived mode only when the historical B73/Y12 figure is the explicit target.
